transcript: Speaker A: I Pooja, I Chennai, I doing hard working person. Speaker B: Naa peru Pooja, nenu Chennai nundi vachanu mariyu nenu kashtapadi panichese vyaktini. [My name is Pooja, I came from Chennai and I am a hardworking person.] Speaker A: My name is Pooja, I am from Chennai, I am a hardworking person. Speaker B: Very good. Speaker C: Hi, nenu ippude meeru English nerchukovadam chusanu. Actually naa English kuda chala weak, app nundi English nerchukovacha? [Hi, I just saw you learning English. Actually my English is also very weak, can I learn English from this app?] Speaker A: Naa English kuda weak ga undi, anduke daily nenu SpeakX app lo English practice chestunnanu. [My English was also weak, that's why I practice English daily on the SpeakX app.] Speaker C: SpeakX app-a, adenti? [SpeakX app, what is that?] Speaker A: Idi oka AI English teaching app. Ikkada AI teachers neeku English practice chepinchi English ela matladalo nerpistaru. Adi kuda emi judge cheyakunda human teachers laga. [This is an AI English teaching app. Here AI teachers make you practice English and teach you how to speak English. That too without judging, just like human teachers.] Speaker C: Kani deeni nerchukodaniki chala time padutundi kada? [But it takes a lot of time to learn this, right?] Speaker A: Ledu, rozuki 15-20 minutes ee app lo practice cheste chalu. 15 to 20 days lo meeru English fluent ga matladataru. Already naa friends andaru fluent aipoyaru. Inka konni rojulalo nenu kuda fluent aipota. [No, practicing 15-20 minutes a day on this app is enough. In 15 to 20 days you will speak English fluently. Already all my friends have become fluent. In a few days, I will also become fluent.] Speaker C: Kani idi chala costly untundi kada? [But this must be very costly, right?] Speaker A: Assalu kaadu, rojuki 4 rupees matrame, 7 days trial kuda teeskovachu. [Not at all, only 4 rupees a day, you can also take a 7 days trial.] Speaker C: Idi naku munde enduku teliyaledu, nenu ippude SpeakX app download chestanu. Thank you. [Why didn't I know this before, I will download the SpeakX app right now. Thank you.]

summary: A woman practices English in a cafe using the SpeakX app, where an AI avatar corrects her broken sentences. A man nearby notices her and asks about the app to improve his own weak English. She explains that the app offers non-judgmental AI tutoring for just 15-20 minutes a day, costing only 4 rupees daily with a 7-day trial, which motivates him to download it.
